method.title: How staff are scored
method.words: FM26 shows staff attributes as words. Each word covers a fixed range of the old 1–20 scale, and is scored at the middle of it (exact numbers are used when an export has them):
method.roles: A role score is the weighted average of the attributes that role uses, with the 17 staff roles and weights from <link>fm-scoring</link>: a community staff rating grid, relabelled for FM27 and checked against the key attributes FM27 highlights on staff profiles. Coaches are split into FM's nine coaching groups, each scored on its two coaching attributes plus authority, determination, motivating, people management and working with youngsters. A generic Coach is scored on their best outfield group. Adaptability, Judging Staff Ability and Negotiating carry no weight in any role. Filtering by preferred job shows only the attributes that job is weighted on. Best role only counts roles where most of the weighted attributes were in the export. Role scores get the same S++ to F grade stamps as player scores, on the same 1–20 steps.

detail.barsNote: Bars run from 0 to 20. * means some of the role's attributes were missing from the export.

backroom.title: Best backroom
backroom.intro: Choose the roles you need and how many of each. Scout Reporter hires the combination of staff with the highest total role score, never using one person twice. Lock in staff you've signed, and remove anyone who turns you down to get the next best pick for that slot.

short.explain: {filtered, select, yes {Staff qualify when most of the role's attributes are in the export, they pass the filters and they are not excluded, and one person can only fill one role.} other {Staff qualify when most of the role's attributes are in the export, and one person can only fill one role.}}

backroom.footer: Each role is scored with fm-scoring's staff weights (see <link>Staff</link>). The backroom shown has the highest total score of every way to fill the roles with different people, so a strong all-rounder goes where they add the most rather than to the first role that wants them. Staff missing most of a role's attributes are not considered for it.
